name: Being Overwhelmed
overview: Scripture reveals that when believers feel overwhelmed, they are called to be still and recognize God's sovereignty, trusting that He will be exalted above all (Psalms 46:10). In moments of distress, the psalmist models turning to God in prayer for help and listening for His guidance (Psalms 61:1; Psalms 119:105). Confidence in the Lord’s enduring goodness and mercy provides a foundation for gratitude and hope (Psalms 118:1), while trusting Him wholeheartedly, rather than relying on our own understanding, leads to renewed strength and perseverance (Proverbs 3:5; Isaiah 40:31).
